principles: Do not reward an unsupported specification
Separate technical capability from reliability evidence and Pakistan after-sales support
Do not treat anecdotes as failure rates
Keep conflicting source values instead of silently selecting a convenient value
Price affects value, not technical quality
Missing data reduces confidence but does not automatically mean the product is bad
Final tiers are derived from the score and evidence confidence, not assigned manually

pillars.name: Reliability & real-world evidence
criteria: length and quality of field history
pillars.important_rule: No statistical failure rate will be inferred from a small number of anecdotes. Evidence strength is scored separately from the direction of the report.

pillars.name: Pakistan value
pillars.important_rule: Value is deliberately limited to 7% so a very cheap inverter cannot outrank a substantially better inverter merely because it is inexpensive.

evidence_scoring.rule: Evidence confidence modifies the criterion contribution; it does not convert unknown into a negative technical claim.

criterion_band.method: Each criterion receives 0-100 before pillar weighting.

missing_data_policy.manufacturer_does_not_publish: Do not assume the value is poor. Score conservatively and reduce evidence confidence.
missing_data_policy.conflicting_sources: Retain all credible values and score using the stronger source while applying a conflict confidence penalty.
missing_data_policy.retailer_only_claim: Do not treat as verified manufacturer specification.
missing_data_policy.community_claim: Useful for real-world evidence only; never convert directly into a statistical failure rate.

reliability_evidence_ladder: manufacturer-confirmed field issue or service bulletin
multiple independent installer reports describing the same issue
multiple independent owner reports with consistent symptoms

tier_mapping.method: Applied only after all candidate scores and evidence-confidence values are calculated.
tier_mapping.confidence_gate: A product with a high numerical score but materially weak evidence may be marked provisional rather than presented as a fully established tier result.
tier_mapping.unrated_rule: A product remains UNRATED if the minimum evidence threshold has not been met, regardless of provisional technical score.

anti_gaming_rules: MPPT count is not an automatic tier criterion; its importance is reflected in the electrical/PV pillar.
Nominal AC wattage does not dominate the score because all candidates already belong to the same 6 kW class.
Price cannot compensate for severe reliability or safety concerns.
Brand reputation alone cannot determine the score.
Anecdotal complaints cannot establish a failure rate.
A manufacturer warranty duration alone cannot prove good after-sales service.
OEM/rebrand identity does not transfer reliability scores between products without evidence.

calculation.rounding: Keep internal calculation to at least 2 decimal places; display one decimal place.
calculation.price_snapshot: Use observed Pakistan street price with date and source; do not use MSRP when street price evidence exists.

methodology_reference.note: The structure is informed by evidence-first inverter scoring approaches that separately evaluate efficiency, design/flexibility, thermal resilience and features, while adapting the weighting to Pakistan-specific warranty, service and price realities.
